<template>
  <v-container>
    <v-row justify="center" align="center" class="h-screen">
      <v-col xs="12" sm="6" md="4" lg="3" xl="3">
        
        <v-card class="elevation-6">
          <v-toolbar class="bg-primary">
            <v-toolbar-title>{{ texts.toolbar }}</v-toolbar-title>
            <v-spacer></v-spacer>

            <v-btn>
              <v-progress-circular
                v-show="isLoading"
                indeterminate
                color="background">
              </v-progress-circular>
            </v-btn>
          </v-toolbar>

          <v-card-text>
            <v-form>
              <v-text-field 
                v-if="!isLogin"
                v-model.trim="v$.user.name.$model" 
                variant="underlined" 
                name="name" label="Nome" 
                type="text"
                :error-messages="nameErrors"
                :color="isNameValid ? 'success' : 'default'">

                <template v-slot:prepend>
                  <v-icon :color="isNameValid ? 'success' : 'default'" icon="mdi-account"></v-icon>
                </template>

              </v-text-field>

              <v-text-field 
                v-model.trim="v$.user.email.$model" 
                variant="underlined" 
                name="email" label="Email" 
                type="email"
                :error-messages="emailErrors"
                :color="isEmailValid ? 'success' : 'default'">

                <template v-slot:prepend>
                  <v-icon :color="isEmailValid ? 'success' : 'default'" icon="mdi-email"></v-icon>
                </template>

              </v-text-field>

              <v-text-field 
                v-model.trim="v$.user.password.$model" 
                variant="underlined" 
                name="password" 
                label="Senha" 
                type="password"
                :error-messages="passwordErrors"
                :color="isPasswordValid ? 'success' : 'default'"
                class="mt-3">
                
                <template v-slot:prepend>
                  <v-icon :color="isPasswordValid ? 'success' : 'default'" icon="mdi-lock"></v-icon>
                </template>

              </v-text-field>
            </v-form>

            <v-btn block flat class="bg-grey-lighten-4 mt-4" @click="isLogin = !isLogin">{{ texts.button }}</v-btn>
          </v-card-text>

          <v-card-actions>
            <v-spacer></v-spacer>
            <v-btn size="large" class="bg-primary text-body-1" :disabled="v$.$invalid" @click="submit">{{ texts.toolbar }}</v-btn>
          </v-card-actions>

          <v-snackbar
            location="top"
            v-model="showSnackbar">
            {{ error }}
            <template v-slot:actions>
              <v-btn color="pink"  variant="text" @click="showSnackbar = false">
                <v-icon icon="mdi-close-thick"></v-icon>
              </v-btn>
            </template>
          </v-snackbar>

        </v-card>
      </v-col>
    </v-row>
  </v-container>
</template>

<script>
import { useVuelidate } from '@vuelidate/core'
import { required, email, minLength } from '@vuelidate/validators'

export default {
  name: 'LoginView',
  setup() {
    return { v$: useVuelidate() }
  },
  data() {
    return {
      error: undefined,
      isLoading: false,
      isLogin: true,
      showSnackbar: false,
      user: {
        name: '',
        email: '',
        password: ''
      },
      isNameValid: false,
      isEmailValid: false,
      isPasswordValid: false,
    }
  },
  computed: {
    texts() {
      return this.isLogin 
        ? { toolbar: 'Entrar', button: 'Criar conta'}
        : { toolbar: 'Criar conta', button: 'Já tenho uma conta'}
    },
    nameErrors() {
      const  errors = []
      const name = this.v$.user.name
      
      if (!name.$dirty) {
        return errors
      }

      !name.required.$response && errors.push('Nome é obrigatório!')
      !name.minLength.$response && errors.push(`Insira pelo menos ${name.minLength.$params.min} caracteres!`)
      
      return errors
    },
    emailErrors() {
      const  errors = []
      const email = this.v$.user.email
      
      if (!email.$dirty) {
        return errors
      }

      !email.required.$response && errors.push('Email é obrigatório!')
      !email.email.$response && errors.push('Insira um email válido!')

      return errors
    },
    passwordErrors() {
      const  errors = []
      const password = this.v$.user.password
      
      if (!password.$dirty) {
        return errors
      }

      !password.required.$response && errors.push('Senha é obrigatória!')
      !password.minLength.$response && errors.push(`Insira pelo menos ${password.minLength.$params.min} caracteres!`)
      
      return errors
    }
  },
  validations: function () {
    const validations = {
      user: {
        email: {
          required,
          email
        },
        password: {
          required,
          minLength: minLength(6)
        }
      }
    }

    if (this.isLogin) {
      this.user.name = ''
      return validations
    }

    return {
      user: {
        ...validations.user,
        name: {
          required,
          minLength: minLength(3)
        }
      }
    }
  },
  watch: {
    ['v$.user.name.$invalid']() {
     if (this.v$.user.name) {
       if(!this.v$.user.name.$invalid) {
          this.isNameValid = true;
        } else {
          this.isNameValid = false;
        }
     }
     
    },
    ['v$.user.email.$invalid']() {
      if(!this.v$.user.email.$invalid) {
        this.isEmailValid = true;
      } else {
        this.isEmailValid = false;
      }
    },
    ['v$.user.password.$invalid']() {
      if(!this.v$.user.password.$invalid) {
        this.isPasswordValid = true;
      } else {
        this.isPasswordValid = false;
      }
    },
  },
  methods: {
    async submit() {
      this.isLoading = true;
      
      try {
        //
        this.$router.push(this.$route.query.redirect || '/dashboard')
      } catch(e) {
        this.error = e.errorMessage
        this.showSnackbar = true
      } finally {
        this.error = 'login não implementado'
        this.showSnackbar = true

        setTimeout(() => {
          this.isLoading = false;
        }, 5000)
      }
    }
  },
}
</script>
